summary: Quantum Corporation filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of Hiral A. Patel as Chief Accounting Officer, effective September 1, 2026. The filing details her compensation package including a $335,000 base salary, 50% target bonus, 50,000 RSUs vesting over three years, and standard change-of-control severance terms. This is a routine executive appointment disclosure without any special-situation characteristics such as a takeover, restructuring, or strategic event. The filing includes standard items 5.02, 8.01, and 9.01, with no indication of abrupt departure or unusual circumstances. The appointment follows her prior roles at Pep Boys, IKEA Retail, and VeriFone. No deal terms or special-situation elements are present.
